drivers: Mixed refinery outages and coker restarts
Petcoke rally above US$100 in October
High freight rates; Americas heavy-oil glut
outlooks.summary: Refinery news is mixed: some outages (Deer Park) but several restarts (Flint Hills, Valero, MOL). Price is down 16% over 3 months, and the supply-pressure score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf Coast coker run rates and freight rates over the next few weeks.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂消息好坏参半:Deer Park出现停产,但Flint Hills、Valero、MOL等焦化装置已恢复。价格3个月下跌16%,供应压力评分接近零。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停工与焦化装置重启并存
10月石油焦价格急升至100美元以上
运费高企;美洲重质原油过剩
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 未来数周关注美国墨西哥湾沿岸焦化装置开工率及运费走势。

outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are sharply reducing cobalt supply, and Chinese export-control uncertainty adds risk. Price fell 24% in 3 months but is up 26% over 12 months, so part of the tightness may be priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota adjustments and China's export-control decisions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额大幅削减钴供应,中国出口管制的不确定性也增加风险。价格3个月下跌24%,但12个月上涨26%,部分紧张可能已被计价。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额压减产量(嘉能可下降52%)
中国出口管制截止日期
刚果华友子公司停产
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额调整及中国出口管制决定。

drivers: Major copper-moly producer slows moly output growth
outlooks.summary: Slower output growth from a major producer and export-control risk point to tighter supply. Price is already up 18% in 3 months and 42% in 12 months, so some of this is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control decisions and producer output guidance.
outlooks.summary_zh: 大型生产商放缓钼产量增长,加上出口管制风险,供应偏紧。价格3个月已上涨18%、12个月上涨42%,部分利多已被计价。
drivers_zh: 大型铜钼生产商放缓钼产量增长
中国出口管制截止日期
加工费创历史低位,供应链受战争冲击
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制决定及生产商产量指引。

drivers: Zimbabwe keeps January 2027 lithium export ban
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe's ban is bullish, but it starts in January 2027 and new upstream capacity offsets it. Price is down 13% in 3 months, and headlines are mostly generic.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Zimbabwe ban implementation details and China's export-control decisions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦出口禁令偏利多,但2027年1月才生效,且新增上游产能形成对冲。价格3个月下跌13%,相关新闻多为泛泛之谈。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦维持2027年1月锂出口禁令
中国出口管制不确定性
宁德时代扩大上游资源布局
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦禁令的实施细节及中国出口管制决定。

drivers: China extended export-control pause to January 2027
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages and curbs on Japan are bullish, but China's two-month extension of the pause eases broader risk. Price is up 36% in 12 months, so much is priced in; targeted shortages remain.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for the January 2027 pause expiry and any easing of yttrium supply to Japan.
outlooks.summary_zh: 钇短缺及对日本的管制偏利多,但中国将暂停期延长两个月,缓解了整体风险。价格12个月上涨36%,大部分已被计价,但局部短缺仍存在。
drivers_zh: 日本钇供应停滞
中国对日本实施出口管制
中国将出口管制暂停期延至2027年1月
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注2027年1月暂停期到期及对日本钇供应是否缓解。

outlooks.summary: Congo conflict and Indonesian cuts are squeezing supply while demand grows faster than refined output. Price is up 56% in 12 months but flat over 3 months, so further upside is plausible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Bisie (Congo) operations and Indonesian export volumes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)冲突和印尼减产挤压供应,而需求增速快于精炼锡供应。价格12个月上涨56%,但近3个月持平,仍有进一步上行空间。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)冲突与印尼减产
需求增长快于精炼锡供应
中国出口管制截止日期
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)Bisie矿运营及印尼出口量。

outlooks.summary: An export deadline and China policy risk are bullish, but headlines are vague. Price has fallen 56% over 12 months, which suggests ample supply for now.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the antimony export deadline and any Chinese licensing changes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口截止日期和中国政策风险偏利多,但新闻较为模糊。价格12个月下跌56%,显示目前供应较为充裕。
drivers_zh: 出口截止日期临近
中国出口管制不确定性
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注锑出口截止日期及中国许可政策变化。

drivers: Rising indium prices; tight minor-metal by-products
outlooks.summary: China export-control deadlines and tight by-product supply point to more upside. Price is already up 67% in 3 months, so part of the move is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's November 27 deadline and licensing decisions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国出口管制截止日期及副产金属供应偏紧,指向进一步上行风险。价格3个月已上涨67%,部分已被计价。
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制截止日期(镓为11月27日)
铟价上涨,副产小金属供应偏紧
芯片与氮化镓需求
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国11月27日的截止日期及许可决定。

outlooks.summary: Refinery news is balanced and the supply-pressure score is near zero. Price is up 15% over 3 months, with firm anode costs supporting it.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US coker run rates and Chinese anode pricing.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂消息较为均衡,供应压力评分接近零。价格3个月上涨15%,阳极成本坚挺提供支撑。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停工与重启并存
中国预焙阳极价格超过6000元/吨
运费高企
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国焦化装置开工率及中国阳极价格。

outlooks.summary: Supply signals are mixed and the score is near zero. Price is down 5% in 3 months but up 46% in 12 months, so much of the rise looks priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch refinery coker restarts and freight rates.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应信号好坏参半,评分接近零。价格3个月下跌5%,但12个月上涨46%,大部分涨幅似已被计价。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停工与重启并存
能源板块上涨与通胀
重质原油运费紧张
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注炼厂焦化装置重启及运费走势。
